_comment: Bash scope policy per handbook ADR 0004 Track 2. Loaded by hooks/pre-tool-use.sh on every Bash tool call. deny_patterns are universal (no agent can bypass). universal_allow lists POSIX shell builtins + harmless flow-control that pass FIRST_TOKEN check for any role (cd, echo, etc. are not real binaries). agent_allow is per-role positive scope; agents not in agent_allow have no Bash by default. Add to agent_allow only via tool-matrix-change decision (cto proposes at company scope / pca proposes at project scope, cso reviews, CEO approves, eng-platform installs at company scope / project's eng-lead installs at project scope) per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 + ADR 0014 §4 single-writer-per-scope.
_compound_command_caveat: FIRST_TOKEN check on per-role allow-list inspects only the first binary in compound commands ('cmd1 && cmd2 || cmd3' → only cmd1 is matched). If cmd1 is in universal_allow (e.g. cd) or in role allow-list, downstream binaries pass UNCHECKED by allow-list. Universal deny-list still applies regex-wide (rm -rf /, force-push, drop table caught regardless of position). v0.8.x candidate: extract every binary from compound commands and validate each.
_v08_rename_note: Per ADR 0014 §1, agent_allow keys renamed at v0.8.0: ca→cto (company scope), project cto→pca (project scope), coo→eng-lead, cdo→design-lead, cpo→product-lead. Project-vpe removed (absorbed by eng-lead per §2); vpe key now refers to the optional company-scope VPE gated by feature_toggles.vpe_enabled. eng-platform allow-list extended with npm/npx/node for npm:publish capability per ADR 0014 §3.
